description: Baklava is a rich, sweet pastry made of layers of flaky filo dough, generously filled with chopped nuts, and sweetened with an aromatic syrup. This iconic Turkish dessert offers a delightful crunch with every bite, followed by a burst of sweet, nutty flavors. Perfect for celebrations or a special treat, it embodies the essence of Turkish hospitality and culinary tradition.

instructions.title: Prepare the Syrup
instructions.text: In a saucepan, combine sugar and water. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes until slightly thickened. Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice, and let it cool completely. The syrup must be cold when poured over hot baklava.

instructions.title: Prepare the Nut Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the finely chopped walnuts or pistachios with cinnamon powder and ground cloves, if using. Mix well to ensure the spices are evenly distributed throughout the nuts.

instructions.title: Prepare the Baking Pan
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 160°C (325°F). Brush the bottom and sides of a 35x25 cm (13x9 inch) baking pan generously with clarified butter. Make sure every corner is coated to prevent sticking and ensure a golden crust.

instructions.title: Layer the Filo Dough
instructions.text: Carefully unroll the filo pastry. Place one sheet of filo dough into the prepared pan, gently pressing it down. Brush the entire surface of the filo sheet with melted butter. Repeat this process for 10-12 sheets, layering them one by one, brushing each with butter.

instructions.title: Add Nut Filling and Continue Layering
instructions.text: Evenly spread half of the nut mixture over the buttered filo layers. Place another 8-10 sheets of filo on top of the nuts, brushing each layer with butter. Spread the remaining half of the nut mixture over these layers. Top with the remaining 15-20 sheets of filo, brushing each sheet thoroughly with butter.

instructions.title: Cut the Baklava
instructions.text: Using a sharp knife, carefully cut the baklava into diamond or square shapes, cutting all the way through to the bottom. This step is crucial for the syrup to penetrate evenly. Do not skip this step before baking.

instructions.title: Bake to Golden Perfection
instructions.text: Bake the baklava in the preheated oven for 45-55 minutes, or until it turns a beautiful golden brown and is crispy. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning, as ovens can vary.

instructions.title: Pour the Cold Syrup
instructions.text: Immediately after removing the hot baklava from the oven, slowly and evenly pour the completely cold syrup over the entire surface of the hot baklava. You will hear a sizzling sound. Let the baklava cool and absorb the syrup for at least 4-6 hours, or preferably overnight, at room temperature.

tips: Clarify your butter by melting it and skimming off the foam, then pouring off the clear butter, leaving the milk solids behind. This prevents the baklava from becoming soggy and gives it a better texture.

Ensure your syrup is completely cold and the baklava is piping hot when you combine them. This temperature difference is key for the baklava to absorb the syrup properly and achieve its signature crispy yet moist texture.
For extra crunch and flavor, lightly toast your nuts before chopping them. Store baklava at room temperature in an airtight container for up to a week, or refrigerate for longer freshness.
